title: 过桥的时间
summary: k 名工人通过单向互斥桥把 n 个箱子从右仓搬到左仓；按效率低者和编号大者优先的规则调度，求最后一个箱子过桥到左侧的时间。
insight: 维护左右两侧等待工人的优先队列，以及正在左侧放箱、右侧取箱工人的完成时间小根堆。每个时刻先释放已完工作业，桥上优先让右侧带箱工人回来，否则派左侧工人；无人可过桥时跳到最近完成事件。
pitfalls: 右侧等待工人的过桥优先级高于左侧
效率以 leftToRight+rightToLeft 越大越优先
派工人去右侧时就消耗一个待搬箱子
答案在最后箱子过桥后即可，不必等其放置完成

solutions.title: 四堆事件模拟
solutions.idea: 等待堆按低效率优先，作业堆按完成时刻优先。
steps: waitLeft 初始放入所有工人，waitRight 空；workLeft/workRight 为完成事件堆
循环直到没有未派箱子且右侧无等待或取箱工人
把完成时间<=current 的 work 工人移入对应 wait
waitRight 非空时最高优先工人回左，current+=rightToLeft，并进入 workLeft
否则 boxes>0 且 waitLeft 非空时派工人去右，current+=leftToRight、boxes--，进入 workRight
否则 current 跳到两侧最近完成时间；返回 current

code.java: class Solution { public int findCrossingTime(int n,int k,int[][] time){Comparator<Integer> waiting=(a,b)->{int first=time[a][0]+time[a][2],second=time[b][0]+time[b][2];return first!=second?Integer.compare(second,first):Integer.compare(b,a);};PriorityQueue<Integer> waitLeft=new PriorityQueue<>(waiting),waitRight=new PriorityQueue<>(waiting);PriorityQueue<long[]> workLeft=new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(event->event[0])),workRight=new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(event->event[0]));for(int worker=0;worker<k;worker++)waitLeft.offer(worker);long current=0;int boxes=n;while(boxes>0||!waitRight.isEmpty()||!workRight.isEmpty()){while(!workLeft.isEmpty()&&workLeft.peek()[0]<=current)waitLeft.offer((int)workLeft.poll()[1]);while(!workRight.isEmpty()&&workRight.peek()[0]<=current)waitRight.offer((int)workRight.poll()[1]);if(!waitRight.isEmpty()){int worker=waitRight.poll();current+=time[worker][2];workLeft.offer(new long[]{current+time[worker][3],worker});}else if(boxes>0&&!waitLeft.isEmpty()){int worker=waitLeft.poll();current+=time[worker][0];boxes--;workRight.offer(new long[]{current+time[worker][1],worker});}else{long next=Long.MAX_VALUE;if(!workLeft.isEmpty())next=Math.min(next,workLeft.peek()[0]);if(!workRight.isEmpty())next=Math.min(next,workRight.peek()[0]);current=Math.max(current,next);}}return (int)current;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun findCrossingTime(n:Int,k:Int,time:Array<IntArray>):Int{val waiting=Comparator<Int>{a,b->val first=time[a][0]+time[a][2];val second=time[b][0]+time[b][2];if(first!=second)second-first else b-a};val waitLeft=java.util.PriorityQueue(waiting);val waitRight=java.util.PriorityQueue(waiting);val byTime=compareBy<LongArray>{it[0]};val workLeft=java.util.PriorityQueue(byTime);val workRight=java.util.PriorityQueue(byTime);for(worker in 0 until k)waitLeft.offer(worker);var current=0L;var boxes=n;while(boxes>0||waitRight.isNotEmpty()||workRight.isNotEmpty()){while(workLeft.isNotEmpty()&&workLeft.peek()[0]<=current)waitLeft.offer(workLeft.poll()[1].toInt());while(workRight.isNotEmpty()&&workRight.peek()[0]<=current)waitRight.offer(workRight.poll()[1].toInt());if(waitRight.isNotEmpty()){val worker=waitRight.poll();current+=time[worker][2];workLeft.offer(longArrayOf(current+time[worker][3],worker.toLong()))}else if(boxes>0&&waitLeft.isNotEmpty()){val worker=waitLeft.poll();current+=time[worker][0];boxes--;workRight.offer(longArrayOf(current+time[worker][1],worker.toLong()))}else{var next=Long.MAX_VALUE;if(workLeft.isNotEmpty())next=minOf(next,workLeft.peek()[0]);if(workRight.isNotEmpty())next=minOf(next,workRight.peek()[0]);current=maxOf(current,next)}};return current.toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int findCrossingTime(int n,int k,vector<vector<int>>& time){priority_queue<pair<int,int>> waitLeft,waitRight;using Event=pair<long long,int>;priority_queue<Event,vector<Event>,greater<Event>> workLeft,workRight;for(int worker=0;worker<k;++worker)waitLeft.push({time[worker][0]+time[worker][2],worker});long long current=0;int boxes=n;while(boxes>0||!waitRight.empty()||!workRight.empty()){while(!workLeft.empty()&&workLeft.top().first<=current){int worker=workLeft.top().second;workLeft.pop();waitLeft.push({time[worker][0]+time[worker][2],worker});}while(!workRight.empty()&&workRight.top().first<=current){int worker=workRight.top().second;workRight.pop();waitRight.push({time[worker][0]+time[worker][2],worker});}if(!waitRight.empty()){int worker=waitRight.top().second;waitRight.pop();current+=time[worker][2];workLeft.push({current+time[worker][3],worker});}else if(boxes>0&&!waitLeft.empty()){int worker=waitLeft.top().second;waitLeft.pop();current+=time[worker][0];--boxes;workRight.push({current+time[worker][1],worker});}else{long long next=LLONG_MAX;if(!workLeft.empty())next=min(next,workLeft.top().first);if(!workRight.empty())next=min(next,workRight.top().first);current=max(current,next);}}return current;} };
